rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for someone who supports a person, idea, or cause.

example.english: I am a proponent of this environmental plan.
example.traditional: 我係呢個環保計劃嘅支持者。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai6 ni1 go3 waan4 bou2 gai3 waak6 ge3 zi1 ci4 ze2

rows.note: Use this casual spoken construction when you want to say explicitly that someone backs A.

example.english: I am the proponent backing this proposal.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai6 caang3 ni1 go3 fong1 on3 ge3 jan4

rows.note: Use this mainly for someone who actively promotes or campaigns for a proposal, policy, or cause rather than merely supporting it.

example.english: He is a proponent of universal retirement protection.
example.traditional: 佢係推動全民退休保障嘅倡議者。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 teoi1 dung6 cyun4 man4 teoi3 jau1 bou2 zoeng3 ge3 coeng1 ji5 ze2
